figures.example_risk: Actual saved L-SML scores for the example on slide 1. Red bars: annotated errors (3–5). This is one example, not a benchmark summary.
figures.nested_banks: N14 ⊂ N16 ⊂ N25 ⊂ N43 ⊂ N56; all three digit channels retained. AUC: 6,030 eligible answers. PRMScore: 6,211 noncontrol answers, Q80. Both metrics use the same saved prediction; LR is fresh source-group OOF. Point estimates, no CI.
figures.leaderboard: Our reruns: same 6,211 noncontrol answers and evaluator port. Our methods/LR: Q80. PRM: native reward <0.5. Published paper rows retain their authors’ protocols; o1-mini uses N=394. This is a selected comparison, not a current live leaderboard.
figures.error_profile: N16; 6,211 noncontrol answers split by type (MS: 160). Our methods and LR: Q80. PRM: native 0.5. Same evaluator and rows. Eight error types use macro-F1; MS is shown separately with valid-step F1 only.
figures.signal_heatmap: All 56 signals + STEP_INDEX. Within-type error/valid eligible answers; 6,030 in total. Raw within-answer AUC with label-free signs; no threshold. Orange outlines guide the three findings. MS has no error/valid pairs and is omitted.
figures.selected_feature_prmscore: Gallery H: individual-feature PRMScore across eight types (6,051 noncontrol answers; MS excluded). STEP_INDEX is newly derived with the same donor/source-fold Q80 (≥). This differs from pooled development Q80 for the main fused scores. No family fusion or CI is shown.
figures.threshold_budget: Sweep of one scalar threshold for each fixed score. X uses all 94,203 steps; Y uses 6,211 noncontrol answers. Markers are the actual operating points. Sweep maxima use evaluation labels and are diagnostics, not deployable selected rules.
figures.count_and_ranking: N16 L-SML; 6,211 noncontrol answers. Six independent interventions, not additive gains. Rows 1–5 retain our ranking. Row 6 retains Q80 counts and replaces ranking with truth. Type-count 68.9 is rounded from v16; remaining values use saved diagnostics.
figures.threshold_and_length: Exactly the same IU-PCR fixed-z>0.5 prediction supplies the threshold table and this count curve. Noncontrol N=6,211; identical length bins. ρ is answer-level Spearman correlation with length. PRM native uses reward<0.5, a different score scale.
